messages:
sam: Quick thread: follow-up on the upgrade RFC — I want to capture a more bandwidth-aware path for on-prem upgrades. Problem: pushing full bundles for every minor model/runtime tweak kills partner links. Idea: sparse-pull + content-addressed chunk dedupe + in-place patching overlay. Short thoughts?
leah: Love it. Need to formalize the index shape so mirrors can answer "what bytes would you actually send me" cheaply.
diego: We can expose a chunk-availability bloom + chunk-size map. Node computes local missing-chunk list and mirror only sends diffs. That avoids full-object roundtrips.
sam: Exactly. Proposal: bundle = manifest + chunk-index. chunk-index is an ordered list of (chunk_id, size, hash, role). Role = runtime|config|model|optional. Mirror exposes GET /index/latest and GET /chunks/check?ids=... which returns availability booleans and compressed ranges.
rachel: For in-place patching: we should use an overlay FS where chunks apply into a staging layer. Activation swaps the overlay root atomically. That avoids double storage for huge models. But watch memory/IO during apply.
diego: For IO safety we should copy-on-write only for modified pages. Large-model chunks that are identical to existing shards are hard links into the new overlay. Saves space and time.
leah: Ops policy around retention: need a dedupe cache retention window so mirrors can garbage collect safely. Manifest should carry a keep-until timestamp for chunks referenced by rolling manifests.
sam: Good point. Add manifest metadata: "persistent_chunks": [ids], and "gc_horizon": RFC timestamp. Mirror GC only removes chunks not referenced by any manifest and older than gc_horizon.
rachel: Upgrade path UX: operator chooses policy: BANDWIDTH_PRIORITIZE (sparse pull), ATOMIC_SWAP (full image), or STREAMING_ACTIVATE (activate with background fetch). Defaults: BANDWIDTH_PRIORITIZE for slow links, ATOMIC_SWAP for secure airgap testbeds.
diego: Fallback behavior: if sparse pull misses > X% of critical chunks within probe window -> fall back to ATOMIC_SWAP if mirror advertises a full-image artifact, else abort and alert. Probe window default 45s.
leah: Security: chunk availability API must not return chunk contents. Only booleans, sizes, and hashes. Require TLS + signed manifest references. Encourage mirrors to rate-limit chunk-check endpoints.
sam: Performance note: chunk-index should be compressed and support range queries (e.g., give me indexes for role=model-shard-0..2). Mirrors can serve a compact bitmap for nodes with lots of chunks.
rachel: Test plan: 1) synthetic network with 10Mbps link 2) simulate churn of 2GB model delta 3) measure bytes transferred for BANDWIDTH_PRIORITIZE vs ATOMIC_SWAP vs STREAMING_ACTIVATE. Also chaos test by dropping 20% of chunk-check responses.
diego: GC coordination: operator can pin manifests to prevent GC; add operator API: POST /pin-manifest/{seq} and POST /unpin/{seq}. Also expose /gc/dryrun to report chunks candidate for deletion.
leah: Add a small example of index shape to the RFC (compact).
sam: Good idea. Example (compact, pseudo-json):
```
index: {
  seq: 1301,
  chunks: [
    {id: "c1a2f", size: 1048576, hash: "sha256:aaa...", role: "runtime"},
    {id: "b77d4", size: 536870912, hash: "sha256:bbb...", role: "model-shard-0"},
    {id: "b77d5", size: 536870912, hash: "sha256:ccc...", role: "model-shard-1"}
  ],
  persistent_chunks: ["b77d4", "b77d5"],
  gc_horizon: "2026-05-01T00:00:00Z",
  sig: "sig:..."
}
```
leah: Nice. Also include an example client flow: 1) GET /index/latest 2) compute missing chunks 3) GET /chunks/check?ids=... 4) request batches via POST /chunks/fetch (mirror streams tar of chunks) 5) apply into overlay 6) activate swap.
rachel: infra-bot: reminder: bench-job scheduled for 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC to compare sparse-pull vs atomic-swap on partner links.
diego: Operational knobs: chunk probe timeout default 10s, parallel chunk fetches 8, chunk batch size 256MB. Make these configurable per mirror.
sam: I'll add this to the RFC follow-up: index shape, chunk-check API, overlay activation pattern, GC pin/unpin APIs, operator policies, test plan, and runbook knobs. Assigning followups: @leah write index schema PR, @diego prototype chunk-check and fetch endpoints, @rachel add overlay activation steps to ops playbook.
leah: I'll start the schema PR.
rachel: I'll draft runbook bullets.
diego: Will share PoC by EOW.
sam: Cool, closing this thread; will post updated RFC link when done. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
